assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production wide landscape banner artwork (3:2) for an original mystery roleplaying game's lobby, hand-painted premium strategy-game environment art. The same unoccupied club reading room and investigator's office as the reference, now on a grey morning. Flat, cool, shadowless daylight comes through the tall sash window on the right; outside, pale grey-white fog hides the street, and the iron street lamp is UNLIT, a dark shape in the fog. The rain has stopped; a few drops remain on the glass. The gas wall brackets are UNLIT: clear frosted globes with no flame. The brass desk lamp with the emerald green glass shade is UNLIT. The walls above the walnut dado rail are now pale cream wallpaper with a faint tone-on-tone damask, lit grey by the morning. The round card table in the foreground and the desk top are still rich billiard-green baize, and green remains the strongest colour in the picture; the leather chairs stay dark bottle green. Dark walnut is only narrow trim: desk edge, dado rail, window frame, bookcase. Small polished brass fittings: drawer pulls, bell push, the magnifying glass and closed pocket watch on the baize. Overall the picture is LIGHT and pale: fog grey, cream and green, with a calm open centre of plain cream wall and green baize so it reads when cropped to a shallow horizontal band through its middle. No warm orange or amber light, no sunbeams, no fire, no fireplace, no candle. No people, no silhouettes, no hats, no pipes, no violin, no paper files, no photographs, no string, no newspapers, no readable book spines, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no logos, no UI widgets, no picture frame around the image, no watermark. Entire canvas opaque edge-to-edge scenery. Painterly realism, tactile cloth nap, soft morning light.

history: First build, 2026-11-22: one generation per slot. The night scene was first painted cold (blue-white gas flames) and repainted warm the same day, when the comparison that mattered became Unquiet Depths, whose night is cold green-black. Art pass 2, also 2026-11-22, decided by the batch coordinator: the corner was a round lit glass boss in a square brass plate (brass-lamp-boss-lit-v1.webp and brass-lamp-boss-unlit-v1.webp, removed), which read as a lit push button; it was repainted as a brass wall bracket carrying a frosted glass globe with a flame, lying on the diagonal so it mirrors into all four corners. Night was green from edge to edge, as Unquiet Depths is: the night page became walnut (walnut-panel-v1.webp, new; the baize now serves day only) and the night scene was repainted with walnut panelling in place of green damask (reading-room-walnut-v1.webp replaces reading-room-lamplit-v1.webp, removed). The frame and the day scene are unchanged. Each file was looked at full size and on day and night pages; the corner was checked in all four corners. Source PNGs are not in the repository.
